Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 31, 2026

Babel Street® was founded on the importance of understanding data, and we value the trust our customers, our partners and our website visitors place in us. The responsible use and protection of personal and confidential information under our care is a core value of Babel Street, Inc. (“Babel Street”). Therefore, we want you to be familiar with how we handle information relating to you as an individual, known as personal information.
